q.instructions: Does the code leave required work unfinished — a placeholder body, a thrown not-implemented, or a TODO on the main path?

criteria.true: a required path is stubbed, throws not-implemented, or is marked TODO/FIXME
criteria.false: every required path has a real implementation

q.instructions: Is a cached or memoized result stored under a key that omits an input the result depends on, so a later call with a different value returns the earlier cached result?

criteria.true: the key leaves out an input that changes the correct result
criteria.false: the key includes every input the result depends on, or there is no caching

q.instructions: Does this file expose, through a public or exported API, a symbol whose name or role marks it as internal (helper, impl detail, underscore-prefixed, "internal", "unsafe")?

criteria.true: a public export exposes an internal-looking symbol
criteria.false: only intentionally-public symbols cross the public surface

q.instructions: Does this component read a whole list or collection from a cell with useData, and then use only one item of it — found by id, key, or index — with no selector argument?

criteria.true: useData(cell) returns a whole list and the component picks one item out of it by id, key, or index
criteria.false: useData gets a selector for the item, the component renders the list it reads, or the cell holds a single record or form draft whose fields are rendered

q.instructions: Does this component subscribe to a cell it only writes — useData, or useData with writable — where the read value never appears in the output?

criteria.true: a cell is read with useData but only its setter is used; the value is never rendered
criteria.false: every value read is rendered, or write-only access goes through useController

q.instructions: Does this component call run, runAsync, set, or update directly in its render body — outside any event handler, callback, or effect?

criteria.true: a run or a cell write sits in the function body and executes on every render
criteria.false: every run or write is inside an onClick, onChange, onSubmit, or other callback

q.instructions: Does this component decide a domain rule itself — a conflict, a merge, validity against saved data, a revision check — instead of rendering a notice or flag that an operation wrote to a cell?

criteria.true: the component compares saved and draft data or applies a business rule to decide what happens
criteria.false: the component renders cells plus view-only formatting (labels, disabled while pending, empty-text checks); rules live in operations

q.instructions: Does this component itself start a fetch, timer, listener, socket, or stream — in its body or in a handler — instead of running an operation with useRun or reading a resource?

criteria.true: fetch, setInterval, setTimeout, addEventListener, EventSource, or a websocket is created in the component
criteria.false: the component only runs operations with useRun and reads cells or resources
